edits.new: (SELECT avg(pp2.total_applications) FROM staging.stg_lever__posting p2 LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_lever__posting_performance pp2 USING(posting_id) WHERE p2.owner_user_id=p.owner_user_id)
(SELECT avg(pp2.posting_performance_score) FROM staging.stg_lever__posting p2 LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_lever__posting_performance pp2 USING(posting_id) WHERE p2.owner_user_id=p.owner_user_id)

(SELECT coalesce(avg(ce.overall_candidate_experience_score),0) FROM staging.stg_lever__application aa LEFT JOIN marts.lever__candidate_experience_insights ce ON aa.opportunity_id=ce.opportunity_id WHERE aa.posting_hiring_manager_user_id=m.hiring_manager_id) avg_candidate_experience_score

(SELECT coalesce(round(count(DISTINCT ii.interview_id) FILTER(WHERE ii.canceled_at IS NULL)*100.0/nullif(count(DISTINCT ii.interview_id),0),2),0) FROM staging.stg_lever__application aa LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interview ii ON aa.opportunity_id=ii.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interviewer_user iu ON ii.interview_id=iu.interview_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interview_feedback fb ON ii.interview_id=fb.interview_id WHERE aa.posting_hiring_manager_user_id=m.hiring_manager_id) interview_success_rate

(SELECT count(DISTINCT iu.user_id) FROM staging.stg_lever__application aa LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interview ii ON aa.opportunity_id=ii.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interviewer_user iu ON ii.interview_id=iu.interview_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interview_feedback fb ON ii.interview_id=fb.interview_id WHERE aa.posting_hiring_manager_user_id=m.hiring_manager_id) interviewer_network_size

(SELECT count(DISTINCT ii.interview_id) FROM staging.stg_lever__application aa LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interview ii ON aa.opportunity_id=ii.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interviewer_user iu ON ii.interview_id=iu.interview_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interview_feedback fb ON ii.interview_id=fb.interview_id WHERE aa.posting_hiring_manager_user_id=m.hiring_manager_id) total_interviews_coordinated

(SELECT count(DISTINCT aa.posting_id) FILTER(WHERE ff.hiring_efficiency_grade='High Efficiency (≥10%)') FROM staging.stg_lever__application aa LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_lever__hiring_funnel_metrics ff ON aa.posting_id=ff.posting_id WHERE aa.posting_hiring_manager_user_id=m.hiring_manager_id) high_efficiency_postings

least(100,greatest(0,round(.25*requisition_fill_rate+.25*high_performing_posting_rate+.25*candidate_hire_rate+.15*interview_success_rate+CASE WHEN avg_total_days_to_hire<=45 THEN 10 ELSE greatest(0,10-(avg_total_days_to_hire-45)*.2) END,0))) overall_performance_score

CASE WHEN overall_performance_score>=80 THEN 'Outstanding Hiring Manager' WHEN overall_performance_score>=65 THEN 'Effective Hiring Manager' WHEN overall_performance_score>=50 THEN 'Competent Hiring Manager' WHEN coalesce(p.total_candidates_managed,0)>=5 THEN 'Developing Hiring Manager' ELSE 'New/Limited Experience' END performance_tier

CASE WHEN high_performing_posting_rate>=70 THEN 'Job Marketing Expert' WHEN avg_candidate_experience_score>=4 THEN 'Candidate Experience Specialist' WHEN feedback_completion_rate_managed>=85 THEN 'Process Coordinator' WHEN avg_total_days_to_hire<=30 THEN 'Fast Decision Maker' WHEN coalesce(r.teams_supported,0)>=3 THEN 'Multi-Team Recruiter' ELSE 'Generalist' END hiring_specialization

(SELECT CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT fb.feedback_form_id)>0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END::DOUBLE FROM staging.stg_lever__application aa LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interview ii ON aa.opportunity_id=ii.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interviewer_user iu ON ii.interview_id=iu.interview_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_lever__interview_feedback fb ON ii.interview_id=fb.interview_id WHERE aa.posting_hiring_manager_user_id=m.hiring_manager_id) feedback_completion_rate_managed

concat(CASE WHEN requisition_fill_rate<50 THEN 'Focus on requirement clarity; ' ELSE '' END,CASE WHEN coalesce(p.avg_applications_per_posting,0)<10 THEN 'Improve job posting appeal; ' ELSE '' END,CASE WHEN interview_success_rate<80 THEN 'Improve interview coordination; ' ELSE '' END,CASE WHEN avg_total_days_to_hire>60 THEN 'Accelerate decision process; ' ELSE '' END) development_recommendations
